## v1.13.0 — 2026-03-25

This release delivers a comprehensive set of production hardening improvements, adding observability tooling, security headers, request tracing, and significantly expanded test coverage. The site receives PWA support and a branded 404 page, while the API gains Prometheus metrics and request correlation.

### 🔧 Improvements

- Introduced X-Request-Id header across all API responses, supporting both server-generated and client-supplied correlation IDs for distributed tracing
- Added Prometheus-format /metrics endpoint exposing generation counts, error rates, token usage, publish events, and rate limiting statistics
- Implemented per-request trace correlation through a new requestLog() child logger that binds the request ID to all downstream log entries
- Deployed Content Security Policy and security headers (X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy) via Cloudflare _headers file
- Documented JWT_SECRET generation command in .env.example for streamlined developer onboarding

### ✨ Features

- Created a branded 404 page with a terminal-themed design that matches the existing site aesthetic, complete with responsive layout and navigation
- Added PWA support with apple-touch-icon (SVG and 180×180 PNG) and a web app manifest across all site pages
- Created a phased down-migration SQL script enabling granular emergency rollback of database schema changes

### 🧪 Tests

- Added 30 unit tests for utility functions covering XSS sanitization (script tags, event handlers, javascript: URLs), JSON parsing edge cases, and request body size limits
- Added 39 unit tests for organization routes covering authentication boundaries, role-based access control, cross-organization isolation, self-modification guards, and input validation

### Contributors

@mttaylor

## v1.13.0 — 2026-03-25

This patch release significantly enhances the platform's production posture by introducing key observability features, strengthening security headers, and expanding test coverage with 69 new tests. The marketing site also receives PWA capabilities and a polished 404 experience.

### 🔧 Improvements

- Implement X-Request-Id header propagation across all API responses, accepting client-supplied IDs (validated against `[\w-]{1,64}`) or generating 12-byte hex identifiers for distributed tracing.
- Deploy a Prometheus-format `/metrics` endpoint that exposes counters for generation totals (by provider), generation errors, AI token consumption, publish events, HTTP requests (by method and status), and rate-limited requests.
- Introduce `requestLog()` utility in the logger module, creating pino child loggers with bound request IDs to enable per-request trace correlation across all downstream log entries.
- Configure Content Security Policy, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy security headers through the Cloudflare `_headers` file.

### ✨ Features

- Design and implement a branded 404 error page featuring a terminal-themed UI consistent with the site's existing visual language, including responsive layout, navigation, and footer.
- Add Progressive Web App support to all site pages with an `apple-touch-icon` (both SVG and 180×180 PNG) and a `manifest.json` enabling "Add to Home Screen" functionality.
- Author a comprehensive phased down-migration SQL script that enables granular rollback of database schema changes across five distinct phases.
- Document `JWT_SECRET` generation with a ready-to-use `crypto.randomBytes` command in `.env.example`.

### 🧪 Tests

- Introduce `utils.test.ts` with 30 tests validating XSS sanitization (script injection, event handlers, `javascript:` URLs, nested attacks), JSON object parsing, type guards, array conversion, and request body size enforcement.
- Introduce `org.test.ts` with 39 tests covering unauthenticated access rejection for all 9 handlers, role-based authorization (member vs. admin vs. owner), cross-organization boundary enforcement, self-modification prevention, and comprehensive input validation.

### Contributors

@mttaylor
